basis: frozen data for the tapered-pot socket cartridge; ancestor blocks byte-copied as data from the accepted R3-I028 lineage at landing75 3e4ba19d705c992700caba9c03316ca2c4b7af4f (tree d5bed71921eb565274fd2ec9a102bb79d518c3e1); read as data, never imported, executed or regenerated; every I031 rule below was frozen BEFORE the first calculation

terminationMetal.identity: Ti-6Al-4V (retained studs, nuts, anchor blocks, bolts)

alBody.provenance: ASSUMED 6061-T6-class modelling record carried from R3-I028; NOT sourced, certified or qualified

sf12.verdict: historical FAIL preserved; the I031 substitution into SF1.2 is UNCOMPUTED/UNKNOWN (separate d60+d20 construction, no resizing assigned)

energy.note: carried predecessor value; NOT recomputed under any changed spring - dependent claim

i028Accepted.basis: accepted R3-I028 result at landing75 (socket_body.json c20cec91); this is the BEFORE state of R3-I031
i028Accepted.alBodyDerivation: i028 Al body per end = inherited Ti bodyKg x 2700/4430 (density substitution at unchanged dimensions)

i031Rules.provenance: ALL values below are FROZEN modelling choices made before the first calculation; none is sourced, certified or tuned; a physical FAIL of any screen is a result, not a defect

geometry.coneRule: internal cone starts at the cord exit at the front bore radius and widens rearward at the half-angle until it daylights into the chamber clear diameter; cone length L = (1.25d - bore/2)/tan(5deg)
geometry.odRule: body OD = retained grip OD over the grip length; rearward OD = min(max(gripOD, coneLocalDia + 2 x frontWall), 3d) where frontWall = (gripOD - bore)/2; chamber OD 3d; flange OD 4d
geometry.clearanceRule: bolt clearance hole = bolt nominal + 0.6 mm; stud clearance hole = d + 0.6 mm

hardware.washerRule: OD 2x nominal, ID 1.1x nominal, t 0.2x nominal; two per cap bolt
hardware.studLengthRule: new stud overall = 1.5d (interior engagement incl. tip) + 0.5d (cap) + exterior extent, where exterior extent = inherited stud overall - inherited body length (3 mm d60 / 14 mm d180-11); old stud length and adjustment travel do NOT survive by name
hardware.studMassRule: prorate inherited studKg linearly by new/old overall length (same M14/M23 turned blank)

newIsolationPerEndKg.provenance: ASSUMED new isolation/seal stock for the added Ti/Al contacts (cap-bolt hole bushings, stud cap-hole seal, bearing-washer isolation) with installation stock; sufficiency UNKNOWN; the retained 0.025 kg/end provision continues unchanged for the retained interfaces

hardware.machiningBasis: of the NEW Al metal (conical body + cap); includes the bolt-head seat relief machined inside the frozen 4d envelope

loads.coneTransfer: frictionless cone bearing, ZERO adhesive-shear credit to aluminium; cord-to-resin embed shear retained as a screen with the inherited ASSUMED 12 MPa design shear
loads.potWedgeModel: cone normal N = T/sin(5deg); uniform normal pressure p = N/lateral frustum area; pot radial approach u = p x r_m/E_resin with r_m = (r0+rL)/2; axial wedge stiffness k_z = k_r tan^2(5deg), k_r = E_resin x A_lat x cos(5deg)/r_m; contact seating displacement UNKNOWN and excluded
loads.resinBearingProvenance: ASSUMED potting-resin compression/bearing working value; confined crushing/creep behaviour UNKNOWN

screens.coneBearing: p vs resin 80 MPa and vs Al 150 MPa working normal-stress record
screens.hoop: local thin-wall sigma = p x r_i/t along the cone and at the chamber entrance (wall 0.25d, r 1.25d); thick-wall and end-effects ignored (declared)
screens.bodyAxial: wall axial stress from the accumulated cone axial component, closed-form integral with the carried load T(x) = T x (ID^2-bore^2)/(2.5d^2-bore^2)
screens.capBending: radial-strip model: line load T/(2 pi r_w) at the bearing-washer mean footprint r_w = 0.75d, cantilever span (1.75d - 0.75d) to the bolt circle, sigma = 6M/t^2, t = 0.5d; upper-bound-style declared frozen screen
screens.boltTension: T_fit/4 per bolt over the ASSUMED tensile area vs 880 MPa Ti
screens.boltBearing: T_fit/4 over nominal x flangeThk bearing area vs 150 MPa Al record; bolt shear none (axial load path)
screens.headSeatBearing: T_fit/4 over the counterbore-floor annulus (headAf+0.4 OD, clearance ID) vs 150 MPa
screens.studTension: T_fit over M14/M23 tensile area vs 880 MPa
screens.loadNutStrip: T_fit over pi x 0.85d x 1.5d thread-shear area vs 0.6 x 880 MPa (Ti-on-Ti, ASSUMED)
screens.washerBearing: T_fit over bearing-washer annulus (1.5d OD, d+0.6 ID) on cap inner face vs 150 MPa
screens.cordEmbedShear: T_fit over pi x cordDia x embedLength vs 12 MPa ASSUMED resin shear

compliance.bodyAxialClosedForm: delta = integral T(z)/(E_Al A_wall(z)) dz, exact antiderivatives by polynomial division; evaluated at T0 (linear elastic)
compliance.lSerRebuild: new lSer = new body axial cord-equivalent + pot wedge cord-equivalent + everything-else term x (new stud length/old stud length), where everything-else = inherited lSer - Ti body term (Ti body term = bodyLen x (E_c/E_Ti) x A_cord/A_bodyTi, A_bodyTi = pi/4(gripOD^2-bore^2)); the everything-else split is an ASSUMED stud-dominated decomposition; cap/contact axial compliance declared second-order and excluded; no friction credit
compliance.propagation: chain denominator and mean-cord denominator rebuilt by +2 x delta lSer per end; n=5 declared-model slack tables scale by the exact new/old denominator ratio; chord-basis tables stay UNCHANGED historical comparators; eta = meanCord/(lEffMean + 2 delta lSer)
compliance.tensionTakeup: tension at unchanged imposed extension scales by old/new denominator; both-end take-up to restore T0 = T0 x 2 delta lSer/(E_c A_cord); adjustment travel availability UNKNOWN

bill.removed: I028 Al body (+ its 3% machining), old stud (replaced by the shorter new stud), old resin pot
bill.retained: cord, clips, anchor blocks, doubler pads, 45/50 mm attachment bolts + shanks, exterior jam nut, retained 0.025 kg/end isolation provision, potting concept (as the new pot), pressure structure, one free-cord/transfer datum
bill.new: conical body (shoulder/chamber/flange, minus 4 bolt holes), pot at the new frustum minus embedded cord, cap (minus 4 bolt holes and stud hole), 4 cap bolts, 4 cap nuts, 8 cap washers, interior load nut, bearing washer, new isolation/seal stock, 3% machining on new Al metal
bill.unsized: station-pitch envelope compatibility (UNKNOWN), adjustment take-up travel (UNKNOWN), pot moulding/insertion process stock (UNKNOWN), contact seating shims (UNKNOWN)
bill.x15Rule: 0.5 x (sockets + blocks + doublers + attachment) x 1.05 recomputed once on the changed sockets line including isolation/machining once, its own 5% assembly share once
